links.outcome: Re-identification of patients from de-identified notes in independent red-team audit
links.effect: A red team working for 3 months on 790 randomly selected patients could not re-identify any of them; system achieved 99% PHI obfuscation and satisfied HIPAA Expert Determination (<5% PHI prevalence).
links.quote: Finally, an independent audit including adversarial testing on 790 randomly selected patients was performed, in which a dedicated “red team” working for 3 months was not able to re-identify any of the patients.

unlisted_practices: Consistent obfuscation, date shifting, and tokenization of identifiers across documents to build a linked longitudinal de-identified dataset
Comparing automated de-identification accuracy against triple manual annotator review

screen.reason: Evaluates a massive-scale NLP de-identification and obfuscation system for clinical notes, including equity audits across demographics and independent red-team adversarial re-identification testing.

primary.practice: automated de-identification, obfuscation, and red-teaming validation
